paragraphs.text: Wombat is a rare green creature type for cards that depicts stocky, burrowing, herbivorous marsupials, about the size of a badger .

The first card to feature the type was Rabid Wombat in the 1994 set Legends . Twenty-six years after the original, Wombat returned as a silver-bordered creature type, on Surgeon General Commander ( Unsanctioned ). It finally made a return to black border in 2024 with Cursed Wombat ( Modern Horizons 3 ).
Surgeon General Commander — a legendary humanoid intelligent Wombat Bat Chameleon hybrid.
